assumptions.correlation_model: nested mixture: paper-shared draw w.p. rho_paper, else record-shared draw across the 4 corpora w.p. (rho_record - rho_paper)/(1 - rho_paper), else independent by corpus
assumptions.eligibility: whitespace-normalised quote is a substring of the normalised gold chunk text
assumptions.estimand: pooled quote@10(S) - quote@10(W), default retriever, 4 corpora equally weighted
assumptions.rate_allocation: equal per corpus; a corpus that cannot carry it (W baseline cap) passes its excess to the others equally
assumptions.units: one paired difference per (Q-eligible record, corpus); clusters = papers

beyond_grid.note: 10 % is the top of the grid, not a bound: at Delta = 0 the S-W discordance can reach about 2 x the pooled W miss rate (~19 %); simulated after the grid, sizing correlation

check_test: cluster-robust Wald z = (D + delta) / SE_robust > z_0.95
primary_test: one-sided NI, H0 Delta <= -delta: sign-flip randomisation test over papers on X_k = T_k + m_k*delta (exact p by lattice convolution in the analysis; standardised form z = sum X / sqrt(sum X^2) > z_0.95 in the simulation)

recommendation.rule: smallest delta in [1, 2, 3] points with NI power >= 0.9 at true Delta = 0 under the sizing case: discordance 10 % (the top of the grid; the S-W discordance is not observable before S exists), rho_paper 0 and rho_record 0.75 (the W-side proxy: 0.005 and 0.74, feasibility.json)

superiority: after NI rejects: exact sign-flip over papers on T_k (z form in the simulation)
